svg.title: Prefill impact
svg.desc: 8K causal MQA, B1/Hq8/Hkv1/D128. BF16 kernel latency falls from 118.6 to 65.0 microseconds, and FP16 from 119.8 to 66.7 microseconds. Values come from the retained data. The development candidate predates final numerical fixes; this is not an end-to-end model benchmark.
